objective: Implement the in-memory cache layer module app/cache_layer.py (get/set with per-id TTL) that the batch endpoint uses to skip repeated store reads, with unit tests
non_goals: No disk or shared-memory backing (assumption A-1)
No invalidation API beyond TTL expiry

acceptance_tests.description: set then get returns the value; get on absent key returns None
an entry read after its TTL elapses returns None from get
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_cache_layer.py::test_expiry asserts None after ttl elapse

failure_cases.expected_behavior: entries are still served until their expiry instant passes — get returns the value, no negative TTL

handoff.notes: record the exact get/set signatures in verified_facts
